aggressive_definition: No aggressive prostate cancer endpoint was analyzed in the abstract.
study_design: Case-control study of prostate cancer patients and age-matched controls.
reason: The abstract reports associations with overall prostate cancer risk only; it does not analyze an aggressive incident subtype.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The consumption of red and processed meat increased the risk of disease by 0.6% (OR= 1.006; 95% CI: 1.00-1.01; p= 0.048) and 7.2% (OR= 1.072; 95% CI: 1.02-1.13; p= 0.012), respectively, for each gram of intake per day.
estimate_classifications.reason: The processed-meat estimate is for overall prostate cancer risk, with no aggressive disease definition or stratification.
